1,621 likes, 3 comments - fitmomclub.co on October 5, 2026: "🔔Save & Share this post with everyone🔔
The foods we eat provide the raw materials our body needs every day. 

Healthy fats support the brain and skin, fibre supports heart and digestive health, and protein helps maintain and repair tissues.

Calcium and magnesium support strong bones, while antioxidants, vitamins and plant compounds help protect cells and support immunity, circulation and organ function.

The simplest approach? Build meals around a variety of whole foods.

#healthyeating #wholefoods #nutrition #healthylifestyle #wellness
